notes: Cash basis county; all funds governmental, no business-type funds. Receipts/disbursements from Exhibit D (p4) Total Governmental Funds column. The 'Taxes' line (5,226,237) is split into property 3,838,874, motor vehicle 203,795, inheritance 1,179,623 and lodging 3,945 using the Statement of Activities (p2); they sum to the line. 'Local receipts' 1,174,355 is kept as one line (charges for services/fees, review): the Statement of Activities shows charges for services 906,945 plus interest 177,355, misc 30,984 and other local grants. 'State receipts' 2,378,573 kept as one state aid line: no schedule prints its breakdown (no homestead/credit/pro-rate lines). Transfers in = out = 1,738,955 (General 50,930 in / 1,139,900 out; Road 1,569,891 in; Inheritance Tax 315,000 out; Nonmajor 118,134 in / 284,055 out); cross-check ties and no transfers are hidden in spending. Reconciles: 5,096,254 + 8,834,801 - 8,819,273 = 5,111,782. Re-check (attempt 2): balance sheet now from Exhibit C Statement of Cash Basis Assets and Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, Total Governmental Funds column (p3), whose totals equal Exhibit A (5,111,782); fund balance by classification (restricted lines, committed 2,500,963, assigned 531,217, unassigned 460,000). Detail: General Fund budget schedule (Sched 2, by department and object; supersedes no other General Fund schedule), Road, Inheritance Tax and Buyback fund budget schedules, and the nonmajor combining schedule Totals column (more than 6 nonmajor funds; Sched 6 per-fund budget schedule not repeated, to avoid double counting). 'Operating expenses' lines use detail_category 'not itemized' (object class not broken down); Personnel services = salaries and wages; Capital outlay = equipment purchases. Taxes on the General Fund schedule kept as taxes (unlabeled) because the tax type split is not printed by fund. Zero actual lines recorded with budget only. ARPA fund and some nonmajor funds had no receipts. Read pages 1-22 of 22
